mechanism_narrative: A sustained decline in the federal funds rate over 3 months indicates the Federal Reserve is shifting to an easing stance, lowering discount rates and increasing equity present value, which drives positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX produces negative 20-day forward returns in > 60% of instances despite a sustained FEDFUNDS decline, or Rank IC < 0.03 over any 2-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: A sharp increase in the federal funds rate above 5.25% triggers a risk-off reaction, compressing discount rates and reducing equity valuations, which produces negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX produces positive 20-day forward returns in > 60% of triggered instances, or Rank IC > 0.03 over any 2-year rolling window.
